name: Bath & tidy
description: Shampoo, blow-dry, brush-out, nails, ears, and a tidy of the face, feet and rear.

name: Full groom
description: Everything in the bath, plus a full haircut to the style you ask for, or the breed standard.

name: De-shed treatment
description: Conditioning soak and a long session with the high-velocity dryer. Less fur on the sofa for weeks.

name: Nail trim & grind
description: Clipped and smoothed. Walk-ins welcome most afternoons.

name: Full day
description: Drop-off by 10am, pick-up by 7pm. Yard play, lunch, a nap, and a report card.

name: Half day
description: Up to five hours. A good start for puppies and older dogs.

name: Ten-day pack
description: Ten full days to use whenever you like, good for a year.

name: Overnight suite
description: A private room with a raised bed, a daytime spot in daycare, and bedtime check-ins.

name: Second dog, same suite
description: Siblings stay together, eat apart, and play in the same group.

name: Going-home bath
description: They leave smelling like they arrived. Better, honestly.

name: Neighborhood walk
description: Thirty minutes, on-leash, solo or with one well-matched friend. Photos sent after.

name: Manners session
description: One hour, one trainer, one goal: loose-leash walking, recall, or greeting without jumping.
